title: Changing the endpoint of reachability
statement: Let $A$ be a machine with memory, let $x$ be an input, and let $G$ be a predicate on configurations. If the machine reaches $b$ from $a$ in finitely many steps while $G$ holds at every configuration strictly before reaching $b$, and $b=b'$, then it reaches $b'$ from $a$ with the same invariant condition.
hypotheses_covered: A finite run reaches $b$ from $a$ and satisfies $G$ at each earlier configuration
